admitted_observations: MCP specification 2025-11-25 separates tools, resources, prompts, lifecycle, and client capabilities
A2A 1.0.0 separates Agent Cards, Messages, Tasks, Parts, and Artifacts from internal agent implementation
SAFe enterprise coordination distinguishes portfolios, value streams, Solution Trains, ARTs, teams, and cadence events
APS requires exclusive receipted actuation and typed refusal

target.consequence: A deterministic Rust simulation demonstrates MCP capability use, A2A peer delegation, bounded SAFe autonomics, receipts, and replay at Fortune-5 scale.

forbidden: claims about a real Fortune 5 company
A2A agents directly mutating enterprise state
implicit MCP or A2A full conformance claims

authority.implementer: Rust simulation kernel and protocol adapters
authority.verifier: GitHub Actions plus deterministic negative fixtures

acceptance.expected: all protocol, broker, and replay tests pass
ALIVE receipt with at least 800 teams and a valid 64-character receipt head
same coordinate produces identical metrics, event count, receipt head, and replay key

falsifiers.observation: An autonomic controller reallocates lean budget without human investment authority.
A capacity rebalance greater than five percent is applied.
An enterprise metric changes through a control action without an actuation receipt.
Two runs with the same config, scenario, seed, and toolchain produce different receipt heads.

checkpoints.claim: Configuration, protocol profile, fixtures, and source invariants are present and parseable.
The Rust crate formats, compiles, and passes clippy.
MCP and A2A fixtures exercise the shared engine and broker.
Human authority and bounded-delta violations are refused with typed receipts.
The Fortune-5-scale scenario executes twice with identical receipt heads.

rollback.rule: Remove the simulation chapter, package, workflow, and work order without altering the APS constitutional chapters.

exclusions: full A2A streaming and push notification support
full MCP sampling, elicitation, and task support
real employee, customer, financial, or operational data
nonclaims: The fictional scale profile does not describe any actual Fortune 5 company.
The implementation is a bounded semantic profile rather than certification for MCP, A2A, or SAFe.
ALIVE standing applies only to the recorded verifier ladder and exact source coordinate.
The simulator does not prove that a real enterprise will achieve the simulated outcomes.
